name: genos_explore
description: INTENT Layer. Asynchronous command (Fire and Forget). The agent provides a problem, and GenOS spawns an ephemeral sub-agent (Surgeon) that manipulates biological tools in the background. The result will be written to the Blackboard. Check genos_read_blackboard to see the result. Requires human validation if the cost is high.

problem_description.description: Description of the problem to solve.

num_branches.description: Number of parallel worlds (branches) to generate. Note: High values will trigger a human validation prompt due to token costs.
